**Finding: compliant (at fallback)** — no redline proposed.

- **Our exit right (§17(b), p0118):** we may terminate at any time on 90 calendar days' written notice, with no early-termination fee or penalty; the only obligations are to cease use and certify return/destruction of the Software.
- **Vendor exit right:** none for convenience. §17(c) allows termination only for insolvency events or an uncured 30-day material default, and §17(a) keeps the licence in effect perpetually while fees are paid.
- **No hidden penalty:** §11 simply cross-refers to the Fee Schedule; no acceleration or exit charge on a convenience termination.

This meets the playbook fallback (customer notice of 60–90 days, fee-free, no vendor convenience right) rather than the preferred 30-day position, so it is acceptable as drafted. Noted for the file only (not deviations): the clause is silent on a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees on our convenience termination — refunds arise only on termination for Garman's default (p0128) or on rejection under §8 — and maintenance runs in renewable one-year terms, so recovery of prepaid maintenance for the post-termination period would need to be handled commercially.
